views.label: Validate and admit
views.note: Identity, scope, policy, and admission fail closed before a harness starts.

views.label: Freeze execution facts
views.note: Configured-harness policy, idempotency, and lease become stable session facts.

views.label: Isolate native execution
views.note: The adapter owns native translation; scoped loopback handles keep credentials out of configuration.

views.label: Normalize and persist
views.note: Native output is normalized and redacted before canonical events and terminal state are appended.

views.label: Project and recover
views.note: ADK Events stream live, and Last-Event-ID resumes from the canonical event log after disconnect.

cards.title: Safe In
items: Identity, scope, policy, and admission precede harness startup
Denied requests create no native work

cards.title: Canonical Through
items: Normalization and redaction precede durable event append

cards.title: Recoverable Out
items: Last-Event-ID resumes from the event log
